findings.impact: Deleting ordinary caches could create a new lifecycle UUID despite an unresolved durable Codex charge, repeating the request and bypassing its budget.
findings.fix: Store lifecycle run identity, cumulative budgets and completed Codex outcomes in independent durable state; reject corrupt runs; reuse recovered outcomes with zero new usage and honor authoritative accounting.
tests: public lifecycle preserves unresolved Codex identity when ordinary cache is lost
completed durable Codex result survives cache loss without another charge
verified durable Codex accounting supersedes stale unknown consumer totals

findings.impact: Explicit CLI Anthropic model/API-key flags could be silently ignored by the new default Codex backend.
findings.fix: Resolve explicit provider choices and layered configuration consistently; reject explicit Codex plus Anthropic model flags before dispatch.
tests: explicit Anthropic CLI flags select their provider after default resolution
conflicting Codex model configuration is rejected before dispatch

findings.impact: Default Codex and durable apply recovery could mutate assets already loaded by an active affected host session without the handoff required on the host path.
findings.fix: Use one backend-independent active-session check on normal lifecycle, durable resume and CLI apply; preserve the concrete preview and next command.
tests: default Codex setup preserves a concrete preview until the affected session ends
durable resume applies the same affected-session handoff as normal setup

findings.impact: Native outputs created before manifest commit could be exported as project evidence after source changes invalidated the interrupted preview.
findings.fix: Persist native intent before generated writes; quarantine exact pending native scopes and block semantic research until receipts reconcile; retain similarly named unowned user files.
tests: interrupted native output cannot become research after source drift rejects resume
native intent quarantines unpublished staging but similar user directories stay visible
